right: Use case: background-extraction. Edit the attached24-frame pixel-art sprite sheet by removing ONLY its brown/red mottled background, replacing it with actual fully transparent RGBA alpha around and between every character. Preserve ALL24 characters and their exact pixel shapes, colors, outlines, poses, positions, scale, 4-column6-row grid and the1024x1536 composition. No new characters, effects, shadows, text, outlines, clothing or anatomy changes. Keep opaque pixels of Agyu intact; do not erase dark outlines, bandana tails, shield, fingers, gaps between legs or boots. Pixels between limbs become transparent naturally. Asset type: production transparent pixel-art combat BODY animation sprite sheet for Agyu.
Reference: first image is the new24-pose RIGHT-facing body sheet; preserve its exact character/style/pose vocabulary, but provide the requested camera direction. Second image is the original character identity/color reference. Agyu has red bandana and tails, short black hair, red gold-trim short-sleeve tunic, brown belt/trousers/boots, round brown shield strapped to back. Small chibi pixel-art hero, crisp dark outlines.
STRICT GRID: exactly FOUR equal columns by SIX equal rows,24 whole weaponless characters, one percell. Constant camera/head/body scale and root position. Portrait2:3 canvas with squarecells and transparent margins betweencharacters. NO words, letters, numbers, cell lines, background, cast shadows, ground, weapons, spear, pole, slash FX or particles.
COLUMN ORDER:1 anticipation/load,2 committed drive/contact stance,3 follow-through/weight transfer,4 balanced recovery. Eachphase has genuinely different knees/stance/hips/shoulder/head position; no four standing duplicates.
ROWS:1Crescent Cut: crouch load→leadfoot step/hip twist→widefollow-through→recover.
2Reverse Fang:rearweightshift→reversehip twist/opposite step→recoil→settle.
3Piercing Lunge:lowcoil→deepforward lunge bentleadknee straightrearleg→strongforwarddrive→springingpullback.
4Rising Talon:deepkneedip→rise onrearheel→liftleadknee athletictransfer→land/settle.
5Whirlwind:crossedfootpivot→vigorouswaisttwist/staggeredfeet→oppositeshoulderfollowthrough→widebrakingstance.
6Sunbreaker:bracedcompressedload→dynamicdrivingstep/liftedrearboot→deepgroundedimpactcrouch→bracedrecovery.
All characters must be complete and intact. Spear is rendered separately, so draw small natural closed gripping fists with anatomically connected bent elbows and straight wrists. Put the spear-gripping fist on SCREEN RIGHT near belt/lower-chest level, a little outside torso; other arm balances. No fists by face, above head, extra arms, inverted hands, or detached hands. Keep faces/boots clear.
IMPORTANT alpha: the final image must have a REAL fully transparent RGBA background around eachsprite. The brown/red mottled background in the first reference is NOT part of the sprite and must NOT be copied. No checkerboard or solid fill. Actual pixel-art sprites isolated on transparency. Preserve pose height differences: crouched heads lower, consistent footbaseline and constant character proportions.

CAMERA DIRECTION: EVERY character faces the viewer FRONT/DOWN (top-down adventure front facing), never a side profile. Head face looks downscreen toward player. Translate stepping/lunging toward camera with clear knee bends and foreshortening while preserving complete boots and torso. Shield mostly behind left shoulder. Spear-grip fist stays SCREEN RIGHT. Match the front view in original sheet.
